name: 98383 · Silverdale, WA
findings: ZIP 98383 (Silverdale) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98383 (Silverdale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98383 (Silverdale) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
